name: the-legacy-program-dashboard-tools
description: Local tooling for the gate. The board itself has no dependencies; these are for the browser checks (tools/*.js) and for serving dist/ over HTTP. The playwright version is PINNED EXACTLY to the one both CI jobs install, because a check that passes on one browser build and fails on another teaches nobody anything, and this repo has already paid for a layout difference between the machine a session runs on and the machine that gates it.
